description: The item's id, assigned once. An archive row's id is its archive.json id and the Photos page link (photos/#historical/<id>); a logo row's is logo- and the file's name, and a lineage card cites it in logo_id.

archive: an item of www/data/archive.json, the Photos page's Historical tab. logo: a logo file under ops/hart-ops/operator_logos/ or www/assets/logos/, including those the lineage charts (www/data/*-lineage.json) show; this file is the one place for logo credits (owner, 2026-11-25).

The file, as the site cites it from www/: ../media/... for an archive original in the gitignored mirrors, ../ops/hart-ops/operator_logos/... or assets/... for a tracked file. archive.json's src and a lineage card's logo copy it.
The full document an archive item's image is the cover or a page of, cited from www/ like path. archive.json's pdf copies it.
An archive item's title, as the Photos page prints it. archive.json's title copies it; the local Photos page's edits write both. Empty on a logo row.
An archive item's caption, as the Photos page prints it. archive.json's caption copies it; the local Photos page's edits write both. Empty on a logo row.

Who made or published the item, as the page prints it. archive.json's credit copies it; for a logo, where the file came from (a Commons or Wikipedia page, a company site, or the file in this repo it was made from).
Where the item can be seen online, when there is such a page.
How sure the credit is: verified (checked against the source), likely (the same item found, the exact copy not checked) or none (not recorded).
The terms the item is shown under, or its licence.
Where the copy in the repo or the mirrors came from (a folder, an email, a download), for people tracing it.
The catalogue row this file was made from, such as a logo cropped from an archive ad or a 320 px square made from a downloaded logo.
